visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are positioned in front of large-scale posters in a brightly lit exhibition hall. The woman on the left is wearing a light blue sleeveless nurse-inspired uniform with pink cross details and a matching miniature hat. The woman on the right is wearing a cat-ear headband with bells, a dark blue and white patterned bikini-style top, and a black pleated skirt. They begin a synchronized dance routine, smiling directly into the camera lens while swaying their hips. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up shot focused on the woman with the cat-ear headband. She performs a series of rhythmic arm movements and rapid chest shakes synchronized with the beat. Her dark hair is styled in a bob with bangs, and her makeup includes decorative glitter under her eyes. The exhibition background shows a poster of a woman in a swimsuit. (3) The scene transitions to a medium shot focusing on the woman dressed in the blue nurse outfit. She exhibits high energy, performing a dance move that involves touching her long dark hair and pointing towards the viewer. She wears red lipstick and has a playful, engaging facial expression. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional event space or studio. (4) Both women return to the frame for the final sequence of the dance. They perform a series of coordinated hand gestures and waist movements. The camera zooms slightly as they conclude their performance with bright smiles. The grey industrial flooring and white partitioned walls of the exhibition booth are clearly visible behind them.

The background music features a heavy 808 bass and sharp snare hits, creating a driving and aggressive rhythmic foundation. Faint ambient chatter from a crowd is barely audible underneath the main track. (2) A male vocal sample repeating the phrase "shake that thing" enters the mix. The delivery is rhythmic and staccato, with a moderate pitch and high intensity. The BGM tempo is approximately 140 BPM. Each repetition of the vocal sample is accompanied by a percussive accent in the instrumentation. (3) A series of rapid camera shutter sound effects ("click-click") are inserted as a sound design element during the visual transitions. These SFX have a sharp transient profile and a short decay. The music volume remains constant, providing a high-energy auditory bed for the sound effects. (4) The vocal sample "shake that thing" continues to loop as the music reaches its conclusion. The harmonic tension remains low as the track follows a simple two-bar repetitive loop. The final sound is a hard cut of the audio track, coinciding with the end of the video. No fading is present.
